writingTask.instruction: 你校英文报“Opinion”栏目正在征稿，请同学们对未来大学生活中的学习（Study）、社交（Socialize）、睡眠（Sleep）这三件事按重要性进行排序，并阐述理由。

taskRequires: 读者是校英文报“Opinion”栏目的同学；身份是投稿的高中生，要表明个人观点。
要点：把学习、社交、睡眠三件事按重要性排序，并说明理由；标题“Ranking My College Life Essentials”须照抄在文首。
taskCard.thisEssayChooses: 本范文选择“睡眠第一、学习第二、社交第三”的排序，用“熬夜后听课一个字也听不进”这一具体情形撑住睡眠的理由，社交放第三但先肯定它的价值；语气是同龄人对未来大一新生说话，结尾给一句可以照做的建议。排序和例子都可以换，交代清楚排序、每项有理由、结尾落到行动这三件事不能少。

standard.essay:
Ranking My College Life Essentials

Of the three essentials of college life, I would rank sleep first, study second and socializing third.

Sleep comes first because everything else depends on it. A student who stays up past midnight may sit through the next morning's lecture without taking in a word. With enough rest, I can think clearly and make the most of every class.

Study ranks second, since learning is why we go to college. Socializing matters too: joining a club or chatting with roommates helps me make friends and learn teamwork. Still, it comes third, because good friends will understand if I say no to a late-night party.

So, future freshmen, protect your sleep first. A clear mind makes everything else easier.

pointMap.point: 对学习、社交、睡眠按重要性排序
pointMap.quote: Of the three essentials of college life, I would rank sleep first, study second and socializing third.

pointMap.point: 阐述睡眠排第一的理由
pointMap.quote: Sleep comes first because everything else depends on it.

pointMap.point: 阐述学习排第二的理由
pointMap.quote: Study ranks second, since learning is why we go to college.

pointMap.point: 阐述社交排第三的理由
pointMap.quote: Still, it comes third, because good friends will understand if I say no to a late-night party.

notes.role: 一句话亮出完整排序，读者不用读完全文就知道作者的立场。

items.quote: I would rank sleep first, study second and socializing third
items.explain: 题目要的就是“排序”，所以开头直接给出三项的名次。用 first, second, third 并列，省掉重复的动词，干净好记，后面三段也按这个顺序展开。

notes.role: 说明睡眠为什么排第一：它是另外两件事的前提。

items.explain: 理由不是“我喜欢睡觉”，而是讲清睡眠和学习、社交的关系：另外两件事都靠它撑着。这样排第一才有说服力。

items.quote: A student who stays up past midnight may sit through the next morning's lecture without taking in a word.
items.explain: 用一个读者熟悉的场景代替“睡眠对健康很重要”这种空话。sit through（硬撑着坐完）和 take in（听进去、吸收）都是地道搭配，比 listen to the class 更准确地写出“人在心不在”。

items.quote: make the most of every class
items.explain: 把话题拉回学习，为下一段“学习排第二”铺路，同时说明睡好觉的实际好处。

notes.role: 交代学习第二、社交第三，并回应“社交不重要吗”这个顾虑。

items.quote: since learning is why we go to college
items.explain: 学习的理由一句就够：上大学本来就是为了学习。理由短而硬，把篇幅留给更需要解释的社交。
先承认社交有价值，再说它为什么排最后。读者可能会想“交朋友不重要吗”，这句先接住这个顾虑，立场显得客观。

items.quote: good friends will understand if I say no to a late-night party
items.explain: 排第三的理由落在一个具体选择上：为了睡觉推掉深夜聚会，真朋友会理解。这句又呼应了第二段的睡眠，三项排序因此连成一体。

notes.role: 直接对读者说话，给出一条能照做的建议。

items.quote: So, future freshmen, protect your sleep first.
items.explain: Opinion 栏目的读者是同龄人，直接称呼 future freshmen 并用祈使句给建议，读者读完知道该怎么做，比 In a word, all three are important 这类套话有用。

items.quote: A clear mind makes everything else easier.
items.explain: 最后一句回到“睡眠是基础”的中心，与第二段首句呼应，收得紧。

expressions.expression: I would rank A first, B second and C third
expressions.function: 一句话交代完整排序，适合所有“排序/选择”类观点题的开头。
说明某一项排第一的原因：它是其他各项的基础。
先肯定、再说明名次，用来解释排最后的一项，避免显得否定它。

advanced.essay:
Ranking My College Life Essentials

When people picture college life, they often imagine late-night parties or long hours in the library. For me, however, the ranking is clear: sleep first, study second and socializing third.

Sleep tops my list because it is the foundation for everything. A student who stays up past midnight scrolling through videos may sit through the next morning's lecture without taking in a word. A good night's rest, by contrast, keeps my mind sharp and my mood steady.

Study comes second, as it is the very reason we go to college. Socializing is not far behind: joining a club or chatting with roommates teaches me teamwork and opens my eyes to new ways of thinking. Still, it ranks third, because true friends will understand when I turn down a late-night party.

So, future freshmen, guard your sleep above all. A rested mind will take care of the rest.

pointMap.point: 对学习、社交、睡眠按重要性排序
pointMap.quote: For me, however, the ranking is clear: sleep first, study second and socializing third.

pointMap.point: 阐述睡眠排第一的理由
pointMap.quote: Sleep tops my list because it is the foundation for everything.

pointMap.point: 阐述学习排第二的理由
pointMap.quote: Study comes second, as it is the very reason we go to college.

pointMap.point: 阐述社交排第三的理由
pointMap.quote: Still, it ranks third, because true friends will understand when I turn down a late-night party.

beyondStandard.quote: When people picture college life, they often imagine late-night parties or long hours in the library.
beyondStandard.explain: 先写大家对大学生活的常见想象，再用 however 推出自己的排序。这种“常见看法—我的看法”的开头适合 Opinion 栏目，也让“睡眠第一”这个立场显得更有新意。

beyondStandard.quote: A good night's rest, by contrast, keeps my mind sharp and my mood steady.
beyondStandard.explain: 标准版只说“想得清楚”，这里用 by contrast 与熬夜的学生对比，并用 keeps my mind sharp and my mood steady 两个并列短语，同时写到头脑和情绪，理由更完整。

beyondStandard.quote: A rested mind will take care of the rest.
beyondStandard.explain: rested 和 the rest 一词两用：睡足的头脑会把其余的事处理好。结尾既落到建议上，又有一点同龄人之间的俏皮。
